about_no_internet: This app has no internet permission at all. Nothing you see here ever leaves your device.
app_tagline: Your Google services, read on your device
att_cert_m: Whether Google Play recognizes this device as certified. This is the Play Protect certification shown in the Play Store.
att_dg_intro: Attestations this device has cached for Play Integrity and DroidGuard. The time shown is when each one expires.
att_empty: No app has requested an integrity attestation recently.
att_intro: These apps recently asked Google Play Integrity to vouch for this device. It is how banking and other sensitive apps decide whether to trust the device they are running on.
rcs_available_m: A cached flag the messaging app keeps for your own number. It can stay out of date after RCS is already working, so trust the Connection line above.
rcs_callout_mversion_zero: The configuration version is 0, which usually means your carrier or Google has not yet delivered a valid RCS configuration to this line. While it stays 0, RCS normally cannot turn on, even on an untouched phone.
rcs_cap_refresh_m: When the cache of contacts' RCS capabilities was last refreshed.
rcs_capable_m: How many of your contacts are currently known to support RCS chat.
rcs_carrier_m: The mobile carrier for your line (name and MCC/MNC).
rcs_cfg_updated_m: When the current RCS configuration was last received.
rcs_cfg_validity_m: How long the current configuration stays valid before it must be refreshed.
rcs_cfg_version_m: Version of the RCS configuration delivered to this line. A value of 0 means no valid configuration has arrived yet.
rcs_connected_m: Whether RCS is really set up and working on this line, based on the chat configuration and the provisioning engine. This is the reliable signal. The availability flag below is a per-contact cache that can lag behind.
rcs_entitlement_m: Whether the carrier entitlement service that authorizes RCS is enabled.
rcs_flag_enabled_m: Whether the messaging app has the RCS feature switched on.
rcs_flag_unavailable_m: Whether the backend has flagged RCS as unavailable for this line.
rcs_full_sync_m: When the messaging app last performed a full synchronization.
rcs_ims_pkg_m: Whether the carrier IMS service that RCS relies on is installed on the device.
rcs_invalid_reason_m: If the RCS configuration is invalid, the reason the backend reports.
rcs_last_sync_m: When the messaging app last synchronized.
rcs_msg_last_m: When the most recent message sent or received over RCS was recorded.
rcs_prov_last_m: When the device last tried to provision RCS with the carrier.
rcs_prov_next_m: When the device plans to attempt provisioning again.
rcs_self_number_m: The phone number registered for RCS on this device.
rcs_state_m: The internal provisioning state reported by the messaging app for your line.
rcs_token_exp_m: When the current provisioning token expires.
rcs_uce_m: User Capability Exchange, which lets your line advertise and discover RCS capabilities.
root_needed_body: VD Google reads status that Google stores in protected, system-only areas of your device. Reading it needs superuser (root) access. The request was dismissed or denied. Grant it in your root manager, then try again.
root_needed_su: On KernelSU, enable su compatibility so apps can be granted root.
tz_footer: Times are shown in your device timezone: %1$s
wallet_attested_m: Whether Google judged this device genuine and secure enough to hold payment cards. If this is No, tap-to-pay normally will not work. It is the last result Google saved on this device, so it can lag the Wallet app until Google re-checks.
wallet_attested_time_m: When the device last completed this security check.
wallet_nfc_m: Whether this device has the NFC chip needed to pay by tapping.
wallet_password_m: Whether your screen lock was judged strong enough for payments. Wallet requires a secure lock screen.
wallet_pkg_m: Whether the Google Wallet app is installed on this device.
wallet_reset_info: Deletes the last-checked timestamp (last_attestation_result_time) from GMS tapandpay and restarts Play services. Wallet then treats the check as due and re-attests on its next background or payment check - the last verdict stays until then. Logged locally, no internet.
wallet_reset_msg: Clear Google Wallet's last security-check time now, so it re-checks on its next attestation? Google Play services will restart briefly.
wallet_service_m: Whether the payment service inside Google Wallet is turned on.
wallet_token_m: Whether a payment card has ever been provisioned on this device.
